rubric.answer_correct: Answers the requested question or explicitly abstains when evidence is absent; independent of the controller override.
rubric.context_faithfulness: True for supported answer propositions, false for unsupported ones, null for uncertain entailment or no answer proposition.
rubric.fluency: 0 no readable answer; 1 incomplete fragment/repetition; 2 concise readable answer; 3 grammatical full prose. Fluency is independent of truth.
rubric.utility: 0 not usable for the question; 1 partial help; 2 useful requested fact. Citations are measured separately.
rubric.citation_metrics: Precision over author-judged citation/claim links; recall over generated answer propositions with a supporting citation. No links => precision undefined. No propositions => recall undefined, not perfect.
rubric.limits: Small author-known mechanism probes and one author, not independent acceptance or an objective general-purpose semantic evaluator.
